notes: Methodology: about 12 searches and 2 page fetches. Direct per-100g retail evidence was thin. Most search hits were Mayway, which does not sell to consumers, and eBay/Walmart listings with no captured prices. Only three herbs have a price anchored to a real listing: Xi Yang Shen (Vitacost 4 oz, USD 38.84), Gou Qi Zi (Viva Naturals 1 lb, USD 9.99), and Da Zao (500 g Sayweee listing, price not captured). The rest are estimates from general North American bulk pricing with a rough 2-4x markup over China wholesale, and are marked low confidence. CNY->CAD (~0.19) and USD->CAD (~1.38) were not used for any figure. Ranges are for test fixtures only, not for real purchasing. Expensive roots (人参, 西洋参) are expected to sit far above the rest. Ranges are wide on purpose.
